design.schedule: 2 treatments x 8 questions x 4 reps = 64 sessions, concurrency 1, counterbalanced
design.E0: control packet = prior lossy projection (kind+label only)
design.frozen_model_config: single devin agent revision; no System One / Memory / model-generated semantics

biggest_win: C2-connector (bounded no-route): E1 used 12.5 tool calls vs E0's 27; 186K vs 545K input tokens; 93s vs 152s wall — the explicit 'no route within depth<=3, not global absence' stops exhaustive searching.
metric_that_got_worse: L2-lookup: E1 +15.3K median input tokens — the faithful packet is larger than needed for a trivial single-match lookup; a bounded/minimal packet would fix it.
hypothesis: CONFIRMED — faithful bounded evidence delivery reduces Agent searches/tool-calls/tokens/wall while keeping correctness non-inferior; cheaper than a better retriever.
